svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Event-driven order processing on AWS
svg.desc: Event-driven order processing on AWS. 12 components in 3 groups. Connections: Customers to Orders API; Orders API to Orders event bus (OrderPlaced); Orders event bus to Fulfillment workflow (fulfillment rule); Reserve stock to Charge payment; Charge payment to Create shipment; Fulfillment workflow to Orders table (order status); Orders event bus to Billing queue (billing rule); Billing queue to Invoice generator; Orders event bus to Order notifications (notification rule); Order notifications to Email subscription; Order notifications to Analytics queue.

text.tspan: One EventBridge bus fans order events out to a Step Functions workflow, a billing queue and an SNS topic
